title: Inukami! Novel Illustrator Kanna Wakatsuki Plans to Sue Publisher WiZH for Alleged Copyright Infringement
content: Light novel illustrator Kanna Wakatsuki wrote on August 24 in a note dated July 9 that that they are planning to sue publisher WiZH for alleged copyright infringement related to Wakatsuki and Mamisu Arizawa's Inukami! novel series. Wakatsuki claims that WiZH released a complete edition digital volume of Inukami!

title: Sony Launches Ad-Supported Live TV on PlayStation 5 in U.S.
content: Sony announced on Monday that it is launching a free ad-supported Live TV service on PlayStation 5 in the United States on the same day. The service features over 100 live channels as well as a library of on-demand entertainment in the media section of PS5.
